cuts.placeText: a stone wine cellar — rows of bottles lying in racks, oak barrels, a tasting table and dim hanging lamps
cuts.scene: she is a sommelier sitting upright at the tasting table, thinking over which bottle to open next
cuts.outfit: a sommelier look fitted to her body — a fitted black vest over a white shirt tied at the waist and a short pencil skirt, bare legs, a silver tasting cup on a chain
